    High-rank conditional chain: ACM ⟹ native non-CEP (edge-free route) #

    This file transports the conditional non-CEP chain to the HIGH-RANK lattices Sp_{2g}(ℤ[1/p]) / SL_n(ℤ[1/p]) (g ≥ 2, n ≥ 3), where the Bruhat-Tits building quotient is a chamber (no Bass-Serre edge), so the rank-1 nonabelian-Borel obstruction is absent. The open hypothesis here is ACM (approximate congruence-monomiality): every regular-trace finite-dimensional asymptotic representation is flexibly-HS close to a congruence-monomial representation. The campaign analysis shows ACM ⟹ flexible HS-stability, and Dogon-Vigdorovich 2025 gives flexible HS-stability + ℤ-central extension ⟹ non-hyperlinear extension ⟹ ¬CEP.

    ACM is carried as the single explicit Prop hypothesis (the genuine open core, at the recognized normalized-HS / non-submultiplicative frontier); it is NOT an axiom and is NOT proved by sorry. The two deep links (ACM ⟹ flexible HS-stability; the Dogon-Vigdorovich central-extension step) carry honest sorry with -- TARGET:. The final composite acm_implies_cep_false is sorry-free given the named links, reusing the group-generic machinery of ConditionalChain.

      def ZFib.CEP.ACM (L : HighRankLatticeData) :
      Prop

      ACM (approximate congruence-monomiality) for a high-rank lattice L: every finite-dimensional approximate representation whose tracial data approaches the regular character is, after flexible dimension change, HS-close to a monomial (congruence-induced) exact representation.

      Stated here at the interface level as the dimension-uniform flexible-repair modulus on the regular-trace sector — the single open hypothesis of the high-rank route. (The campaign reduces its sign to one character-theoretic quantity: the maximal monomial overlap of a cuspidal representation; o(dim) ⟹ ACM false, bounded below ⟹ ACM holds.)
